description.value: Monte Creek Winery sits on a 1,200-acre property about 10 minutes east of Kamloops in BC's Thompson Valley appellation, with 75 acres of certified-organic vines across three vineyard sites. Visitors are welcomed year-round in the tasting room and seasonally at The Terrace Restaurant, which overlooks the river valley and surrounding vineyards. The winery has hosted public events since 2015 and runs an active summer event calendar including markets, yoga sessions, and live music.
